title: Restriction and direct-image section models for injective roofs
statement: For an open U of a scheme X, global sections after restriction of a module to U are naturally isomorphic to sections on U. The comparison is restrictAppIso on the whole open subscheme followed by transport along the equality that its image is U. The private section API computes the restriction/direct-image comparison on the prescribed restricted injective resolutions.

source.place: Tags 01E4 and 01FB: restriction to opens and the canonical section formula

proof.text: Use restrictAppIso at the whole open subscheme and the equality that its image is U. Naturality is presheaf naturality along that equality.

Prove the private one-degree restriction/direct-image section formula by the existing raw restriction-adjunction calculation. These provide the section APIs used by the restricted classical roof proof without unfolding its large comparison data. The canonical top-section pushforward comparison is the proved construction in ModuleCohomologyFMap.
